name: issue-triage
title: Issue triage
description: Daily: first response, labels and analysis for new issues, milestones for issues without one, and the organisation issue fields on every open issue.
notes: issue_fields is optional: without organisation issue fields (Priority, Effort, Start date, Target date), bin/issue-fields exits 2 or 3 and the routine skips that step; triage and milestones still run.
